latin: Qui annotauerit diligenter dicta ab aristotele in expositione definitionis de anima, uidebit cur Orpheus Palladi et Veneri uigilantiam attribuerit.
translation: He who diligently notes what was said by Aristotle in his exposition of the definition of the soul will see why Orpheus attributed wakefulness to Pallas and Venus.
